summary: Kitchen has fabric near the range surface and an unsecured floor runner.

hazards.title: Towel hanging on oven handle
hazards.detail: Fabric hanging directly on the oven door handle can ignite if the cooktop or oven heats.
fixSteps: Move the towel to a hook or holder away from heat sources.
Keep the oven handle clear of hanging fabrics.

hazards.title: Unsecured kitchen floor runner
hazards.detail: Unanchored runner rug on smooth hardwood creates a slip or curl trip risk.
fixSteps: Place a non-skid rubber rug pad directly underneath.
Ensure edges lie completely flat against the wood floor.

products.name: Non-Slip Rug Pad Gripper
products.reason: Prevents runner from bunching or shifting on hardwood floors.

products.name: Magnetic Kitchen Towel Bar
products.reason: Allows towels to hang away from the oven door and range heat.
